item.title: Word of the Day: Digestif
item.description: Phonetic: /di·ges·tif/ Part of Speech: Noun Definition a drink or portion of food drunk or eaten in order to aid the digestion. A digestif is a high-alcohol, often herbal-forward spirit, fortified wine, or brandy served neat after a meal to aid digestion and close the dining experience.
